name: Natural Weapon
body:
Natural Weapon
Source Advanced Player's Guide pg. 124
If the ranger selects natural weapon, he can choose from the following list whenever he gains a combat style feat: Aspect of the Beast, Improved Natural Attack, Rending Claws, and Weapon Focus. At 6th level, he adds Eldritch Claws and Vital Strike to the list. At 10th level, he adds Multiattack and Improved Vital Strike to the list.
